galvanic-cell.alt: A zinc-copper galvanic cell. Left beaker: zinc strip in zinc nitrate, the anode, where Zn is oxidized to Zn2+ and the strip loses mass. Right beaker: copper strip in copper(II) nitrate, the cathode, where Cu2+ is reduced to Cu and the strip gains mass. Electrons flow through the wire and a voltmeter from zinc to copper. In the KNO3 salt bridge, nitrate ions move toward the anode beaker and potassium ions toward the cathode beaker.
